size_rule: Strict <= 8,000,000,000 parameters in full unquantized checkpoint metadata; active/core/effective counts do not determine inclusion. Nominal 7B/8B exceptions retained separately for review.
notes: Reasoning mode duplicates are retained as configurations, not counted as different checkpoints. Distinct Think/Instruct checkpoints remain separate.
Availability is a snapshot of verified files, not an exhaustive assertion that other formats do not exist.
GGUF, ONNX, MLX and MLC are not interchangeable. MLX was not inventoried because it is a native Apple runtime, not our browser runtime.
GGUF bit codes use mixed tensor precision; they are not necessarily uniform bits per parameter.
MLC q4f16 and q4f32 both use four-bit weights; f16/f32 is activation precision. q0f16 is unquantized FP16.
File bytes are download/storage evidence, not peak RAM/VRAM. Tokenizer/config/projector files may add download bytes.
Multimodal candidates are for a future text-only workload unless explicitly benchmarked for other modalities. Some MLC exports include only the text decoder.
No browser execution, quality benchmark, runtime upgrade, or production catalog change was performed.
